en.issues.reason.reopen.title: Reopen this issue
en.issues.reason.reopen.blurb: Posted as a comment before the status flips, where whoever picks the work back up reads it — say what regressed or what is still wrong.
en.issues.reason.reopen.placeholder: e.g. the login redirect still 500s on a fresh session — trace in the last comment

en.issues.reason.needs_info.blurb: The work stops until a person acts, so say what they are being asked for — posted as a comment before the status flips. Nobody can answer a question that was never written down.
en.issues.reason.needs_info.placeholder: e.g. which environment did you see this on, and was the user an org admin?
en.issues.reason.on_hold.title: Put this issue on hold
en.issues.reason.on_hold.blurb: A hold pauses the work deliberately until someone resumes it where it stopped. Say why, so whoever picks it up knows whether the reason still stands.
en.issues.reason.on_hold.placeholder: e.g. paused until the billing migration lands next sprint
en.issues.reason.dropped.title: Drop this issue
en.issues.reason.dropped.blurb: Dropping says this work will not be done. The reason is posted on the thread, where anyone who finds the issue later reads why.
en.issues.reason.dropped.placeholder: e.g. superseded by ISS-412, which covers the same flow
en.issues.reason.move_anyway.title: Move this issue anyway
en.issues.reason.move_anyway.blurb: This moves the issue on without what it is waiting for. Say why in one line: it is posted on the thread, where the next run reads it before it stops the issue again.
en.issues.reason.move_anyway.placeholder: e.g. settled on the call — the build can go on without the tenant
en.issues.reason.not_needed.title: The question is not needed any more
en.issues.reason.not_needed.blurb: Withdraws the open question with your reason and resumes the issue where its work stopped, in one move. The reason is posted on the thread and kept on the question.
en.issues.reason.not_needed.placeholder: e.g. the owner decided in standup — ship the smaller reading

en.issues.reason.void_questions.blurb: An agent asked a person something on this issue and nobody has answered. Finishing the work withdraws those questions — say why they no longer matter, and that sentence is recorded on each one. To answer them instead, cancel and use the Decisions panel on the issue.
